title: Player-turned-doctor Laurent Duvernay-Tardif is working with the Chiefs' medical staff

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Player-turned-doctor Laurent Duvernay-Tardif is working with the Chiefs' medical staff
sources.description: Former Chiefs offensive lineman Laurent Duvernay-Tardif, who got his medical degree while playing in the NFL, is back in Kansas City working with the Chiefs' medical staff.
